geographic_note: Ohio SBDC network serves Ashtabula County businesses through regional centers. No dedicated Ashtabula County SBDC office exists; closest centers are in Kirtland (440-525-7706) and Elyria (440-366-4370).

target_buyer_1.organization: Ohio Small Business Development Centers (State Network)
target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Key resource for fostering entrepreneurship and driving growth across Ohio. Past 5 years impact: served 45,227 small businesses, provided 295,000+ hours of no-cost confidential business advising, hosted 3,250+ webinars and workshops. Services help business owners plan, launch, and grow. Business-planning MVP would integrate seamlessly with their statewide advising infrastructure and standardize plan outputs across all centers.

target_buyer_2.organization: Ohio SBDC at Lakeland Community College (Kirtland)
target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Closest SBDC center to Ashtabula County (approximately 30-40 miles). Serves Lake County and surrounding Northeast Ohio region including Ashtabula County businesses. Provides no-cost confidential business advising and training. Business planning tools would extend their reach and help standardize plan outputs for entrepreneurs in the region.
